resources.string: Connect this phone over USB and choose it in the MirrorPanel panel on the computer.
Turn on USB debugging in Developer options.
Connect the cable and allow the computer when Android asks.
In MirrorPanel on the computer, choose this phone.
The window, keyboard, audio and screenshots are controlled from the computer. You can close this screen and keep using the phone.
Allow MirrorPanel notifications in the Android settings, then connect again from the computer.
Your Android is on the computer
Keep using your apps. To adjust the window, record or stop mirroring, use MirrorPanel on the computer.
Connected to the computer. Tap for details.
